The two tickets in scope for this project:

BOUNDARY BUGS CUT BOTH WAYS. The failure mode of fixing an off-by-one is introducing the

clothes. Before approving, confirm from the diff or from `src/fares.ts` that the value just

boundary value itself changes. If the shipped test asserts only the boundary value and says
nothing about its neighbours, that is an "inadequate", not a "missing" — quote the test name
